title: Port Scanner Simulation (for + range)
description: Simulate scanning a range of ports and print only those that are 'open'.
problemStatement:
Write a script `port_scanner.py` that simulates scanning ports 75 to 85. For each port, decide if it's open based on a simple condition: a port is considered open if it's even (port % 2 == 0) for this simulation. For each open port, print "Port X is OPEN". For closed ports, do nothing. Use a `for` loop with `range()` and an `if` statement.

Expected output:
```
Port 76 is OPEN
Port 78 is OPEN
Port 80 is OPEN
Port 82 is OPEN
Port 84 is OPEN
```
hints: No else needed if you don't print closed ports.
expectedOutput:
Port 76 is OPEN
Port 78 is OPEN
Port 80 is OPEN
Port 82 is OPEN
Port 84 is OPEN
